method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridians and two engraved parallels were followed through water and dense geological hatching and measured at all eight crossings. Folds, hatch stripes, shoreline, roads, text and the frame were excluded before opposite corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 61d10mW, 61d05mW, 61d00mW and 60d55mW. The latitude rules are 46d25mN and 46d20mN. Full-resolution crops distinguish the fine rules from a pale fold, broad lithology stripes, shoreline and labels.
